gaps.quote: The target permutation is the reordering that the next stage needs of the transform output.
gaps.note: The page names a 'next stage' it never describes, so the reader cannot tell which reordering the target permutation is, or why the identity keeps it (line 134 'it keeps the target permutation').

gaps.quote: In the paper the same formula absorbs the reordering into the chirp exponents, so no separate permutation pass is needed
gaps.note: This asserts an identity that absorbs the reordering into the chirp exponents, which the page never states; the reader cannot check it from the page, and the paper is only cited.

gaps.term: zeta^n = -1 for the chosen square root
gaps.note: The step needs zeta^n = -1, which the page never establishes for a general square root zeta of omega; it is only given for the example zeta = e^{pi i/n}, so the claim that the chirp has period n is not checkable from the page.
